Name: Get Dressed Natural Dresser Recolour
Author: TheWolfInBlue
Description:
I wanted a darker more natural look to my Get Dressed mod so I went ahead and made one myself
Just uploading if anyone else wants to use it too

You will of course need to download the GetDressed mod [u]first[/u] to use this
which is located here:
http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331/?

Edit: added a little pumpkin addon cuz I like setting pumpkins on everything in october

Remember to only pick one file to use!

To Install:[list]
[*]Open Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\GetDressed
[*]Open the Overrides folder
[*]and replace the dresser.png file with mine
[/list]
That's all~ Enjoy

Downloads.Description: Natural Recolour for the GetDressed Mod

Manifest.Name: GetDressed
Manifest.Description: Adds a dresser in the farmhouse that you can use to edit your character again
